title: interactive-calibration-wizard
rawUserRequest: 循环执行 docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-25-interactive-installation-calibration-wizard.md 的全部工单流程；本 Work Item 实现校准向导核心流程并完成完整治理生命周期。

declaredIntent.summary: Implement the bounded interactive calibration wizard adapter over existing authoritative calibration capabilities.

outOfScope: Installation wizard behavior and entrypoint routing
Changing CalibrationSession state transitions or Candidate Activation semantics
New recovery/error UX beyond the core wizard adapter
Release publication and unrelated governance refactors

sources.reason: Defines the ten-stage calibration wizard scope and verification requirements.
Defines calibration, Candidate Activation, and Active Configuration terminology.
Authoritative project readiness facts reused by the adapter.
Authoritative persisted session state transitions reused by the adapter.
Existing calibration boundary inventory and stage-related facts.
Existing guard validation used by self-check and simulation.
Regression evidence for session persistence and transitions.
Regression evidence for proposal and calibration validation behavior.

riskAssessment.reason: The adapter is local and deterministic; it coordinates persisted calibration state and activation confirmations while delegating authoritative transitions to existing modules.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized serial execution and the bounded adapter can be implemented with existing authoritative calibration modules.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm fixed stage order, persisted resume semantics, separate confirmations, and fail-safe activation delegation.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A direct calibration wizard entrypoint and Make target render exactly ten ordered stages and reuse authoritative doctor, proposal, session, self-check, simulation, and activation paths.
Y/N/Input/Unknown/N/A responses are represented without duplicating session transitions; N/A requires a reason and Unknown remains visible.
Back, Pause/Resume, stage self-check, full self-check, governance simulation, final review, and separate Reviewer/Owner confirmations are covered by deterministic tests.
Candidate Activation is invoked only after both confirmations and preserves the original Active Configuration when the delegated activation fails.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Fresh calibration session renders the fixed ten stages in order
Paused session resumes at the persisted stage without losing answers
Back navigates without duplicating authoritative session transitions
Self-check and governance simulation reuse existing validation paths
Activation requires separate Reviewer and Owner confirmations and preserves Active on failure

guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: Operators need a resumable, human-centered calibration flow over the existing Project Doctor, Proposal, CalibrationSession, self-check, simulation, and activation capabilities. A new adapter must expose the fixed ten-stage journey without creating a second source of truth for persisted state or activation.
constraints: Keep the fixed ten-stage order and standard-library/runtime compatibility.
Reuse existing authoritative session transitions and Candidate Activation logic; do not duplicate them.
Do not activate or mutate Active Configuration before explicit separate Reviewer and Owner confirmations.
Keep Unknown explicit, require a reason for N/A, and make Pause/Resume deterministic and safe.
intent.rationale: A thin adapter provides the requested interactive journey while preserving the repository's existing calibration invariants and failure behavior.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized the complete serial Work Item execution; Makefile entrypoint is within this Work Item scope.
